name: Moldova
headline: Moldova: +2.4% growth in 2025, 7.8% inflation, debt 39% of GDP
sections: Moldova is a $20.3 billion economy (2025), the world's 135th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +2.4% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $20K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 7.4% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 7.8% in 2025, above typical targets, down from 28.7% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 3.8% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 4.2% (2025).
Gross government debt is 39% of GDP (2025), a low level. The general government balance is −3.9% of GDP (2025), a deficit beyond the common 3% benchmark.
The current account balance is −19.7% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 93% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 2.3% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 49% of GDP by 2031, still rising from today's level. Life expectancy is 71.3 years (2024). Population: 2.4 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
